scope: Pre-November DeepSeek V4.1 Flash on four RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q. Earlier V4 and V4-0731 runs used distinct checkpoints. These are baselines by workload, and cannot isolate the effect of Pearl.

long_decode.profile: 250W/card, TP4/EP4 MXFP4 MoE with FP8 KV, NVMe Engram plus 64 GiB host cache, 409600 window, .85 static, 2048 chunks, DSPARK block 5.
long_decode.procedure: Three sequential /v1/responses streams, no prefix hits or overlaps; varied synthetic reference plus technical handbook, thinking disabled, temperature 1, top_p .95, 8192 maximum, natural EOS.
long_decode.effective_prefill_definition: input token count / client time to first nonempty text; includes HTTP and admission
long_decode.quality: All three passed SSE sequence and text-reassembly checks; outputs passed heuristic repetition/markers checks. Semantic correctness was not scored.

full_prefill.procedure: One user message with a unique nonce, repeated synthetic reference records, and a final request for the number 42. Uncached, thinking disabled, temperature 0, no tools, 64 output-token budget, two tokens returned. Throughput uses native prefill_finished_time - forward_entry_time. The 409397 NVMe case had another request waiting near the end.
rows: RAM, capped KV, no expandable segments

memory.oom_condition: Same 524177-token payload failed at 0.90 with Starfield consuming GPU memory; subsequent idle-GPU replay passed. GPU cap was not recorded uniformly across these trials.

cache_pressure.procedure: 64 sequential deterministic-random English reference inputs of exactly 256000 tokens, each with a case-specific 6-digit code, plus 8 exact replays. Max 16 output tokens, temperature 0, thinking disabled, 256 GB host KV HiCache.

operator_traffic.profile: TP4/EP4, 524288 context, .87 static, RAM Engram, 2048 chunk, prefill/decode interval 4, DSPARK 5, up to 8 scheduled requests, 256000000000 bytes host KV split 67% SWA / 33% FULL.
operator_traffic.interpretation: Observational traffic with high cache reuse, mixed concurrency and idle periods. It supplies no controlled concurrency curve or c1 cold-input reference. The run ended in a host OOM.

public_reproduction.historical_commands: Retrieve the public generators at the specified revision. Original harness entry points depend on the historical private logging deployment. A fresh nonce and /v1/tokenize calibration reproduce the workload family.
